reason: Savers runs company-operated thrift stores selling donated secondhand clothing and household goods, with supply bought from nonprofits. Upbound is a lease-to-own and fintech business. It leases new furniture, appliances and electronics through Rent-A-Center and Acima, and it runs the Brigit financial app. Recurring lease payments and app fees are a different way to make money from retail sales of donated goods. The products also differ: secondhand apparel versus leased durable goods. Both serve budget-constrained consumers, but that is too loose to count as real overlap.
